create_optimizer_radamschedulefree: create a RAdamScheduleFreeClosure optimizer instance with custom learning rate and betas for PyTorch model training
configure_schedulefree_closure_step: configure the step method with a closure that evaluates model loss at an extrapolated point for optimization
enable_foreach_optimization: enable foreach-backed parameter updates in RAdamScheduleFreeClosure for faster and memory-efficient training
set_silent_sgd_phase_warmup: set silent_sgd_phase to True in RAdamScheduleFreeClosure to skip early SGD updates during training warmup
apply_weight_decay_schedulefree: apply weight decay with polynomial weighting in the moving average of RAdamScheduleFreeClosure optimizer
